carskog: carski — imperial; gen. case masc. sg.
crkne: crknuti — to die (of animals); 3rd pers. sg.
da: conjunction: that, so that; da + verb = infinitive («da vidim» — to see); also «yes»
dogovore: dogovoriti se — to agree; 3rd pers. pl.
dosta: adverb: quite a lot; dosta dobro — quite good
drugoga: drugi — other; gen. case masc. sg.
društvo: noun neut.: privredno društvo — business company
ga: short form of njega; «ili ti ga» — «or, in other words» (colloquial)
guvnu: guvno — threshing floor; loc. case sg.
i: conjunction; before the word — «and, also, even»
ide: ići — to go, to ride; gde se ide — where you need to go
ima: imati — to have; ima = «there is, there exists»
je: biti — to be, 3rd pers. sg.; auxiliary verb past; je l' — «really, or what»
jedno: jedan — one, neut.; before the number — «approximately» (jedno tri kilometra)
kaza: kazati — to say; past 3rd pers. sg.
koje: koji — which; neut. sg. or acc. pl.
na: preposition: na jugu — in the south, na Instagram — in Instagram
nađe: will turn out, will be found
ništa: at the beginning of a sentence — «well then, anyway»
njega: on — he; gen./acc. case: pored njega — past him
od: preposition + gen. case: jedno od naselja — one of the settlements
ogrnuo: ogrnuti — to throw over; past masc. sg.
opazi: opaziti — to notice; past 3rd pers. sg.
otide: otići — to go away; 3rd pers. sg.
ovrgoše: ovrgnuti — to thresh; aorist 3rd pers. pl.
očiju: oči; gen. pl.: preko očiju — in sight, s očiju — out of sight
pa: particle at the start of a line — «well»; conjunction — «and, therefore»
padne: pasti — to fall; pre nego što padne mrak — before it got dark
po: po mraku — in the dark; po jedan — one by one; dva i po — two and a half
podijeli: podijeliti — to divide; aorist 3rd pers. sg.
pomisli: pomisliti — to think; past 3rd pers. sg.
pope: popeti se — to climb up; past 3rd pers. sg.
posijaše: posijati — to sow; aorist 3rd pers. pl.
povezaše: povezati — to tie up; aorist 3rd pers. pl.
pozva: pozvati — to call; aorist 3rd pers. sg.
pođe: poći — to go; past 3rd pers. sg.
požeše: požeti — to reap; aorist 3rd pers. pl.
prepadne: prepasti se — to get frightened; 3rd pers. sg.
puta: put — road, way; gen. case: preko puta — opposite, across the road
rasrdi: rasrditi se — to get angry; 3rd pers. sg.
rastaviću: rastaviti — to separate; 1st pers. sg. future
sa: preposition + instr. case; + gen. case — «with, from» (sa mape — from the map)
sad: = sada; e sad — well then, so
sam: biti, 1st pers. sg.: rekao sam — I said; also «myself»: sam sebi — to oneself
se: reflexive particle: slikamo se — we take photos of ourselves
skoči: skočiti — to jump; past 3rd pers. sg.
staše: stati — to stand, to begin; aorist 3rd pers. pl.
strašnoga: strašan — terrible; gen. case masc. sg.
sve: sav — all; neut. sg. or pl.
ti: pronoun «you»; short form «you (dat.)» (gde ti je telefon — where is your phone)
u: preposition: + loc. case — where, + acc. case — where to
ukrašću: ukrasti — to steal; 1st pers. sg. future
uplaši: uplašiti se — to get scared; past 3rd pers. sg.
uze: uzeti — to take; past 3rd pers. sg.
uzoraše: uzorati — to plough; aorist 3rd pers. pl.
već: adverb «already»; after negation — «a» (nije selo već gradić)
za: preposition: za to — for this; skretanje za — turn onto
zakopa: zakopati — to bury; aorist 3rd pers. sg.
